findings.excerpt:
lemma coindBasisMap_surjective
    (V : ModuleCat.{u} k) (b : Basis ι k V) :
    Function.Surjective (coindBasisMap (R := R) V b) := by
findings.problem: The inherited finite-dimensionality assumption on R excludes infinite-dimensional algebras even when the supplied basis is finite. The proof only needs a common finite support for the coordinate maps, which a finite index type supplies independently of R.
findings.proposed_change: Outside the [FiniteDimensional k R] context, expose the generalized statement `lemma coindBasisMap_surjective_of_finite_or (V : ModuleCat.{u} k) (b : Basis ι k V) (hfin : Module.Finite k R ∨ Finite ι) : Function.Surjective (coindBasisMap (R := R) V b)`. In the first branch, install the finite-module instance and use the existing proof. In the second, install `Fintype.ofFinite ι`, take `s := Finset.univ`, and use the vacuous support bound in place of finite_support_map; the coefficient construction and reconstruction argument remain unchanged. Derive the corresponding bijectivity result using the already unrestricted injectivity lemma. Keep the existing statements as convenient corollaries, and optionally expose a [Finite ι] wrapper.
findings.benefit: Allows the same coinduction decomposition for finite-dimensional V over arbitrary k-algebras, including infinite-dimensional ones. An empty basis and the zero algebra require no additional assumptions: the support argument still works. Some finiteness condition remains necessary for the general infinite-basis case.

findings.excerpt:
omit [FiniteDimensional k R] in
lemma moduleCoindInclusion_mono (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) : Mono (moduleCoindInclusion k R M) := by
findings.problem: The monomorphism result is restricted to algebras over fields, although its evaluation-at-one argument works for restriction–coextension along any ring homomorphism. This prevents reuse for non-field bases such as ℤ.
findings.proposed_change: Prove a general theorem with statement `lemma restrictCoextend_unit_mono {A B : Type u} [Ring A] [Ring B] (f : A →+* B) (M : ModuleCat.{u} B) : Mono ((ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj f).unit.app M)`. Apply `ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective`, evaluate an equality of images at `(1 : B)`, and simplify `1 • x = 1 • y`, exactly as in the current proof. Keep moduleCoindInclusion_mono as its specialization at `algebraMap k R`. Using the adjunction directly avoids the Field requirement baked into the imported `coind` abbreviation.
findings.benefit: Makes the canonical coinduction embedding available for arbitrary ring maps, including the ℤ-based adjunction used in Mathlib's enough-injectives construction. Neither injectivity of f nor nontriviality of B is needed; the evaluation-at-one proof also covers zero rings.

def restrictCoextendScalarsAdj {R : Type u₁} {S : Type u₂} [Ring R] [Ring S] (f : R →+* S) :
    restrictScalars.{max v u₂, u₁, u₂} f ⊣ coextendScalars f :=

lemma ModuleCat.enoughInjectives : EnoughInjectives (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) :=
  EnoughInjectives.of_adjunction (ModuleCat.restrictCoextendScalarsAdj.{max v u} (algebraMap ℤ R))
